source.firmware_feature_integration: Controller/wrapper slice B in progress separately; no feature-enabled physical qualification.

contract.wire: PSST 1 12, twelve lowercase 8-digit hexadecimal u32 words

behavior.request_success: Observed exact engine-accepted ticket, not structural stop, delivery or healthy data.
behavior.receipt_success: Coherent-enough bracketed raw diagnostic receipt; failure/invalid history is retained without automatic qualification.
behavior.cache: Refresh only acquisition_enabled from hardware; successful stop does not clear streaming, disable IRQ, abort acquisition, flush pilot, release banks or close buffers.
behavior.timeout: Acceptance timeout retains staged/pending state; no fabricated cancellation and no automatic abort.
behavior.idempotence: Same nonzero accepted ticket is replayed unchanged; no wrap and no inferred next operation. A vanished accepted ticket after poll returns an error.
behavior.known_rejections: Malformed/sequence/busy/disabled/fatal health return typed errors; receipt remains separately readable.

irq_error_modes: Release failure after all chunks pushed

limitations: Mocks execute actual C but model hardware/MMIO/poll/locks/kfifo.
The mock poll performs eight steps; configured 10 ms does not establish measured wall-clock or native IIO/network latency.
Sequential interleaving proves mutex boundaries and continued IRQ logic, not real concurrent scheduling.
Hardware ticket/idempotence/fence correctness requires separate RTL and radio evidence.

independent_review.followups: Added independent receipt-field transitions and native replay/pending cases after review; controller joint tests remain separate.

c_to_ppu.scope: Offline mock receipt only; does not admit ABI1.6 in native PPU IIO clients.
